scripts.clean:win: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path .next) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .next }; if (Test-Path node_modules\.cache) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force node_modules\.cache }"
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean && npm cache clean --force
scripts.clean:all:win: npm run clean:win && npm cache clean --force
scripts.fresh: npm run clean && npm run dev
scripts.fresh:win: npm run clean:win && npm run dev
